newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eastman Chemical is cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eastman Chemical is cut.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Paul Raman said he cut Eastman Chemical Co to neutral from attractive. He cited a recent profit warning.
-- He said he cut his 1996 earnings per share view to $5.20 from $5.70.
-- He cut his 1997 EPS view to $5 from $6, and his 12-month price target to $65 from $75.
-- "We do not view the rate of return as being high enough to warrant an attractive rating, especially in light of continually falling estimates," Raman said.
